answer.rationale: The incumbent has the strongest evidence of delivery continuity, while prior benchmarking reportedly improved both price and payment terms. With the line at 94% committed volume and no buffer, an immediate primary-vendor switch could increase delivery risk despite meeting the spend target. I would verify the incumbent-stability and renegotiation records before pursuing a narrowly scoped negotiation; it remains uncertain whether the incumbent can reach the mandated 18% reduction within 14 days.
